scope: Local synthetic product. Named remote deployment evidence is a separate population.

questions: Name the shade of a clear sky.
Name the colour of spring grass.

assumptions: The fixture host supplies the subject and isolates the trusted administrative surface.
Local transactions have SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializable writer exclusion, unique keys, durable commit on a supported local filesystem.
Canonical intent values in the sealed route use ASCII keys and strings with ordinary JSON arrays and objects.
An external dispatch cannot be inferred from a timeout. Independent owner evidence is needed for settlement.
A local text classifier and fixture terms qualify only the named synthetic service.

The Python fragment translator recognizes total Boolean decision expressions over built-in Boolean values. SQLite, cryptographic primitives, host time, CPython, Lean kernel and hardware are in the trust boundary.
